name: The Goddess and Grocer
note: Agrees with OpenStreetMap. Read: Fulton Market 911 W Randolph St, Chicago, IL 60607 Open All Week 7:00 AM - 8:00 PM Thanksgiving Eve | 8:00 AM-6:30 PM Thanksgiving | 8:00 AM-4:00 PM Black Friday | 8:00 AM-8:00 PM OSM's website, goddessgrocer.com, is no longer the shop's (now a nutrition blog); read on the shop's own site, goddessandgrocer.com, block for this address. The Thanksgiving Eve / Thanksgiving / Black Friday lines were ignored. The shop calls itself an 'Australian-style deli' ('a place to walk to for great coffee, freshly prepared food'): possibly not a cafe, left for the coordinator.
